message:
You know, there’s something oddly satisfying about being prepared when the weather turns a bit dicey. Remember that time I mentioned checking the forecast before planning a picnic? Well, let’s just say my friends ended up enjoying their sandwiches in my living room instead of on the soggy lawn. 

With storms rolling in, it’s a good reminder to brush up on a few safety tips. The National Weather Service has some great resources that can help keep us all a little safer and less soggy. 

What’s your favorite trick for staying dry during a storm? ☔
